title: SDK client deprecation and migration playbook
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: PRD-level playbook to sunset legacy client SDKs (legacy-js-client v1.x and legacy-py-client v0.*) and guide customers through migration to the unified Redwood SDK (redwood-js v3 / redwood-py v3). This document defines goals, scope, migration strategy, acceptance criteria, required docs/automation, and rollback/communication plans. Focus is on minimizing breaking changes, providing automated codemods, and delivering enterprise migration support for customers on Dedicated and Private deployments.
out_of_scope: server-side runtime changes (handled by runtime-1.20 team)
model architecture changes or model sunsets - those are handled by ModelOps
acceptance_criteria: Codemod tool released for JS and Python with >=90% automated migration coverage for top 20 community usage patterns
Migration guide published in docs.redwood.ai with step-by-step examples for chat, streaming, embeddings, and function calls
SDK compatibility layer (compat v1) shipped that proxies old endpoint names for 6 months with monitoring and quota controls
Telemetry dashboard created to track migrations, broken clients, and error classes by customer tier
Top 10 enterprise customers (by spend or usage) either migrated or have documented migration plans before sunset date
migration_steps: Inventory: compile list of active SDK versions and top call patterns from usage telemetry
Design: finalize API surface differences and mapping table between legacy and new SDK calls
Implement: build compatibility shim in redwood-sdk v3 that logs deprecation warnings and supports key legacy call shapes
Codemods: implement jscodeshift and lib2to3-style scripts for automated code updates; run internally on example repos
Docs: create migration guide, FAQ, breaking changes table, and sample PRs for GitHub
Beta: invite early adopters and 10 enterprise customers to migration pilot; collect feedback and fix gaps
Rollout: enable automatic compatibility shim in hosted API for customer clusters with opt-out, publish deprecation schedule
Enforcement: begin strict enforcement at sunset date (return 4xx with migration diagnostics), with enterprise exceptions handled case-by-case
rollout_timeline: 2025-11-15: publish initial PRD and announce internal migration working group
2025-12-08: deliver codemod alpha + compatibility shim prototype
2026-01-15: docs + migration guide public beta; begin enterprise pilot migrations
2026-02-28: compatibility shim GA; telemetry dashboard live
2026-05-31: soft-sunset (deprecated warnings return 299 + header); community outreach waves begin
2026-08-31: hard-sunset (deprecated endpoints return 410) except for approved enterprise exceptions
